---
title: "Figure 3 — WGCNA proteome co-expression modules"
author: "Sun et al."
output: html_document
---

**Purpose:** Self-contained reproduction of Figure 3 panels.

The combined Whole Proteome Module (WPM) analysis was run on ANOVA-significant proteins
across all conditions (C×WT, C×rim15KO, P×WT, P×rim15KO) using imputed expression data.
The resulting WGCNA object is stored in `output/wgcna/all_ratio_networkConstruction-auto.RData`.

**Panel A** is a workflow diagram created in Adobe Illustrator; no R code.

**Inputs:**
- `output/wgcna/all_ratio_networkConstruction-auto.RData` — combined WPM analysis
- `tables/master_tidy_protein.csv` — normalized protein expression
- `tables/wgcna_GO_simplified_imputed.csv` — simplified GO enrichment per WPM (q < 0.01, BP)

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("figure3/Figure3.Rmd")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)

out_dir  <- "figure3/plots"
data_dir <- "figure3/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
# Combined WPM analysis across all conditions
# Objects: MEs (48 × 7), moduleLabels (named int), moduleColors (named chr), geneTree
load("./output/wgcna/all_ratio_networkConstruction-auto.RData")

# Module number → WPM label (module 0 = grey/unassigned)
wpm_map <- c("0" = "unassigned",
             "1" = "WPM1", "2" = "WPM2", "3" = "WPM3",
             "4" = "WPM4", "5" = "WPM5", "6" = "WPM6")

# Per-protein module assignments (exclude unassigned)
module_df <- tibble(
  protein_id = names(moduleLabels),
  module_num = as.integer(moduleLabels),
  wpm        = wpm_map[as.character(moduleLabels)]
) %>%
  filter(module_num != 0)

module_sizes <- module_df %>%
  count(wpm, name = "n_proteins") %>%
  arrange(wpm)

# Master protein expression (pivot to long)
master <- read_csv("./tables/master_tidy_protein.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(normalized_ratio, normalized_intensity, ratio, intensity),
               names_to = "data_type", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(data_type = recode(data_type,
    "normalized_ratio"     = "normed_ratio",
    "normalized_intensity" = "normed_intensity"))

# Simplified GO enrichment (q < 0.01, Biological Process)
go_data <- read_csv("./tables/wgcna_GO_simplified_imputed.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(module), module != 0) %>%
  mutate(wpm = paste0("WPM", module))

message("WPM sizes: ", paste(module_sizes$wpm, module_sizes$n_proteins, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))
```

## Panel B — Module eigengene heatmap

Rows = all 48 samples (2 nutrients × 2 genotypes × 4 timepoints × 3 replicates),
annotated by nutrient, genotype, timepoint, and replicate.
Columns = WPM1–WPM6 module eigengenes.

```{r panel-B}
# Build ME matrix: rows = samples, cols = WPM1–WPM6 (drop ME0 = grey)
me_mat <- as.data.frame(MEs) %>%
  dplyr::select(ME1, ME2, ME3, ME4, ME5, ME6) %>%
  dplyr::rename(WPM1 = ME1, WPM2 = ME2, WPM3 = ME3,
                WPM4 = ME4, WPM5 = ME5, WPM6 = ME6)

# Order rows: C before P, WT before rim15KO, T00→T30, R1→R3
row_order <- rownames(me_mat)[order(
  sub("_.*", "", rownames(me_mat)),                            # nutrient
  sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", rownames(me_mat)),          # genotype
  as.integer(sub(".*_T(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", rownames(me_mat))),  # time
  sub(".*_R(\\d+)$", "\\1", rownames(me_mat))                 # replicate
)]
me_mat <- me_mat[row_order, ]

# Row annotation
ann_row <- data.frame(
  nutrient  = sub("_.*", "", rownames(me_mat)),
  genotype  = sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", rownames(me_mat)),
  time      = sub("^.*_(T\\d+)_.*", "\\1", rownames(me_mat)),
  replicate = sub(".*_(R\\d+)$", "\\1", rownames(me_mat)),
  row.names = rownames(me_mat))
ann_row$time <- factor(ann_row$time, levels = c("T00", "T06", "T16", "T30"))

ann_colors <- list(
  genotype  = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
  nutrient  = c("C"  = "#ff9500", "P"       = "#8300ab"),
  time      = c("T00" = "#fee8d0", "T06" = "#fdad60",
                "T16" = "#e85d04", "T30" = "#7f1900"),
  replicate = c("R1" = "#bae6c8",  "R2" = "#44c76d", "R3" = "#016320"))

breaksList <- seq(-0.07, 0.07, by = 0.0001)

ph_B <- pheatmap(
  me_mat,
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "RdBu")))(length(breaksList)),
  breaks            = breaksList,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_cols      = FALSE,
  annotation_row    = ann_row,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  main              = "Whole-proteome module eigengenes",
  fontsize          = 8,
  silent            = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3B_ME_heatmap.pdf"), width = 5, height = 8)
grid::grid.draw(ph_B$gtable)
dev.off()
grid::grid.draw(ph_B$gtable)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(me_mat) %>% rownames_to_column("sample"),
  file.path(data_dir, "Fig3B_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig3B: ", nrow(me_mat), " samples × ", ncol(me_mat), " WPMs saved")
```

## Panel C — WPM eigengene × trait Pearson correlation

Rows = WPM1–WPM6; columns = timepoint, carbon starvation, phosphorus starvation, WT, rim15Δ.
Cell text shows Pearson r (p-value).

```{r panel-C}
# Trait variables encoded numerically from sample names
meta_df <- data.frame(
  time_num   = as.integer(sub(".*_T(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", rownames(me_mat))),
  carbon     = as.integer(sub("_.*", "", rownames(me_mat)) == "C"),
  phosphorus = as.integer(sub("_.*", "", rownames(me_mat)) == "P"),
  wt         = as.integer(sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", rownames(me_mat)) == "WT"),
  rim15      = as.integer(sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", rownames(me_mat)) == "rim15KO"),
  row.names  = rownames(me_mat))

# Pearson r and p
cor_mat  <- cor(me_mat, meta_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
pval_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(cor_mat), ncol(cor_mat),
                   dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cor_mat)))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(cor_mat)))
    pval_mat[i, j] <- cor.test(me_mat[, i], meta_df[, j])$p.value

# Display text: r on first line, p on second
display_txt <- matrix(
  paste0(sprintf("%.2f", cor_mat), "\n(", sprintf("%.1e", pval_mat), ")"),
  nrow = nrow(cor_mat), dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat))

# Rename columns for display
colnames(cor_mat) <- c("Time", "Carbon\nstarvation", "Phosphorus\nstarvation",
                        "WT", "rim15\u0394")
colnames(display_txt) <- colnames(cor_mat)

ph_C <- pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  color           = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdBu")))(100),
  breaks          = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows    = FALSE,
  cluster_cols    = FALSE,
  display_numbers = display_txt,
  number_color    = "black",
  fontsize        = 9,
  fontsize_number = 6,
  main            = "WPM eigengene \u00d7 trait Pearson correlation",
  silent          = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3C_ME_trait_correlation.pdf"), width = 5, height = 4)
grid::grid.draw(ph_C$gtable)
dev.off()
grid::grid.draw(ph_C$gtable)

write_csv(
  as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>% rownames_to_column("WPM"),
  file.path(data_dir, "Fig3C_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig3C: correlation matrix saved")
```

## Panel D — GO Biological Process enrichment per WPM

Rows = GO terms (q < 0.01, simplified); columns = WPM. Cell color = −log10(adj. p-value).

```{r panel-D}
if (nrow(go_data) > 0) {

  go_wide <- go_data %>%
    mutate(neg_log_p = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Description, wpm, neg_log_p) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = wpm, values_from = neg_log_p, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Description")

  # Ensure all 6 WPM columns present
  for (w in paste0("WPM", 1:6)) {
    if (!w %in% colnames(go_wide))
      go_wide[[w]] <- 0
  }
  go_mat <- as.matrix(go_wide[, paste0("WPM", 1:6)])

  ph_D <- pheatmap(
    go_mat,
    color        = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FF3333"))(50),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main         = "GO Biological Process enrichment per WPM\n(\u2212log\u2081\u2080 adj. p-value, q < 0.01)",
    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize     = 9,
    silent       = TRUE)

  pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3D_GO_heatmap.pdf"), width = 7, height = 8)
  grid::grid.draw(ph_D$gtable)
  dev.off()
  grid::grid.draw(ph_D$gtable)

  write_csv(
    as.data.frame(go_mat) %>% rownames_to_column("GO_term"),
    file.path(data_dir, "Fig3D_source_data.csv"))
  message("Fig3D: ", nrow(go_mat), " GO terms plotted")
}
```

## Panel E — Per-WPM expression trajectories

Mean normalized ratio (± SEM) over time for each WPM, faceted by WPM and nutrient,
with WT (gold) and rim15Δ (teal) overlaid.

```{r panel-E}
module_traj <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype != "spike-in", nutrient %in% c("C", "P")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(data_type == "normed_ratio") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value)) %>%
  inner_join(module_df %>% dplyr::select(protein_id, wpm),
             by = c("Protein IDs" = "protein_id"))

# Per-WPM protein count in this dataset
mod_n <- module_traj %>%
  group_by(wpm) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(`Protein IDs`), .groups = "drop")

module_summary <- module_traj %>%
  mutate(samplingTime = as.integer(sub("T", "", samplingTime)),
         genotype     = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "rim15KO"))) %>%
  group_by(wpm, genotype, nutrient, samplingTime) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sem_val  = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups  = "drop") %>%
  left_join(mod_n, by = "wpm") %>%
  mutate(wpm_label = paste0(wpm, " (n=", n, ")"),
         wpm_label = factor(wpm_label,
                            levels = paste0(paste0("WPM", 1:6),
                                            " (n=", mod_n$n[order(mod_n$wpm)], ")")))

p_E <- ggplot(module_summary,
              aes(x = samplingTime, y = mean_val,
                  group = genotype, color = genotype)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_val - sem_val,
                  ymax = mean_val + sem_val,
                  fill = genotype),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(wpm_label ~ nutrient,
             labeller = labeller(
               nutrient = c("C" = "Carbon starvation",
                            "P" = "Phosphorus starvation")),
             scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
                     labels = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15\u0394")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
                    labels  = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15\u0394")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 6, 16, 30)) +
  xlab("Hours post nutrient depletion") +
  ylab("Mean normalized ratio (\u00b1 SEM)") +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.title     = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3E_WPM_trajectories.pdf"),
       p_E, width = 6, height = 10, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(p_E)

write_csv(module_summary, file.path(data_dir, "Fig3E_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig3E: WPM trajectory data saved")
```
